bridge_id: CHANGE-ME: an id for this bridge that is not the small node's own id, e.g. furcate:bridge:<name>

leaves.name: CHANGE-ME: the operator's name for the micro processing node
leaves.key: CHANGE-ME: p256:<hex>, from `furcate-leaf-link enrol` reviewed by the operator

module.name: CHANGE-ME or delete this block when no sensing module is behind the leaf
module.serial: CHANGE-ME: as configured on the leaf
module.device_id: CHANGE-ME: 16 hex digits, as configured on the leaf
module.device_addr: CHANGE-ME: 12 hex digits, as configured on the leaf
